items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: I don't know Freddie. ... I ain't never even know Freddie. ... I might not have forgotten him.

ctx.x: Who had the band in charge?

Oh, that's uh, uh, Freddie. What's Freddie really nice? I don't know Freddie. You don't know Freddie? You don't know Freddie? You don't know Freddie? You don't know Freddie? You used to play around time? Freddie trumpet player? Freddie? Freddie. Freddie? Yeah. Freddie Kepa? No. Freddie, that's all I know. Freddie, I ain't never even know Freddie.
You must have come there after I left.
